# STARR-OMOP Docs

> Stanford Electronic Health Record data in OMOP Common Data Model version 5.4

## Pages

- [STARR-OMOP v5.4](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/starr_omop54.html): Stanford Electronic Health Record data in OMOP Common Data Model version 5.4
- [OMOP CDM v5.4 Data Model](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/omop_data_model.html): What each table holds and how Stanford populates it
- [FAQ](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/faq.html): Frequently Asked Questions for STARR-OMOP
- [About](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/about.html)
- [Page Not Found](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/404.html)
- [Changes from OMOP-CDM 5.3 to 5.4](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/changes_53_to_54.html)
- [Released Datasets](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/released_datasets.html)
- [Getting Access to STARR-OMOP v5.4](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/getting_access.html)
- [OMOP Data Dictionary](https://shiny-funicular-j1po82z.pages.github.io/about/omop_data_dictionary.html): Every STARR-OMOP CDM v5.4 table and field in one searchable page, downloadable as an Excel workbook.
